svg.title: SQS coroutine message flow
svg.desc: SQS coroutine helpers create and locate queues, send single or batch messages, receive up to ten messages, change visibility, delete messages, and reject invalid inputs before network calls.
svg.text: Messages move through an SQS queue; coroutine helpers keep queue URL, visibility, and deletion boundaries explicit.
create queues, page list queues, and resolve queue URLs before message calls
single send validates queueUrl and messageBody; batch send rejects empty entry sets
SQS returns messages with receiptHandle; delete only after processing succeeds
invalid parameters fail locally before SQS receives a request
Delete with the receiptHandle after processing succeeds.
Batch responses can contain both successful and failed entries.
Application code gets suspend SQS operations while queue URL, visibility, deletion, and validation boundaries stay explicit.
